lines.en: I walk slower than I look.

lines.zh: 我的身体边缘不太清楚。
lines.en: The edges of my body are unclear.
I step, and it looks like sliding.

lines.zh: 我不踩实地，只踩个大概。
lines.en: I don't step on anything solid, only roughly.
My outline fades in the light.

lines.zh: 我身上没有脸，你照样认得我。
lines.en: I have no face, and you know me anyway.

lines.zh: 我走过末地的石头，没有声。
lines.en: I cross end stone without a sound.

lines.zh: 我一走，附近的空气就歪了。
lines.en: When I move, the air nearby skews.
I stop, as if thinking.
My shadow isn't directly below me.
I shift a block, then stop.
I drag something that isn't there.
I stand on the End highlands.
My eyes are two voids.

lines.zh: 我的身体好像少了一点。
lines.en: My body seems to be missing a piece.
I listen to a very thin sound.

lines.zh: 我不动，光就从我身上穿过去。
lines.en: I stay still and light passes through me.

lines.zh: 我在想一个问题的形状。
lines.en: I am thinking of the shape of a question.
My fingers reach very long.

lines.zh: 我把头歪成不合适的样子。
lines.en: I tilt my head to an impossible angle.
All nearby sounds have gone distant.
I count the blocks here.
I slowly gather my body in.
Can you see me clearly?
I stand before you.
Your shape is very fixed.
I try to copy you.
You have colour on you.
I reach out; you can't see it.
I am some distance off, and very close.

lines.zh: 你在这里待久了会头晕。
lines.en: Stay here long and your head will swim.
We two are not quite alike.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的时候我不见了。
lines.en: When you blink, I'm gone.

lines.zh: 边缘一收，我又站在这儿。
lines.en: My edges draw in, and here I am again.

lines.zh: 你的影子很清楚，我的不是。
lines.en: Your shadow is sharp; mine isn't.

lines.zh: 我试着把手放在你肩上。
lines.en: I try to lay a hand on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你的颜色在我身上散开。
lines.en: Your colour spreads over me.
I withdraw, my shape a little wrong.

lines.zh: 我不太确定这算不算疼。
lines.en: I'm not sure this counts as pain.
I slowly gather myself in.
I wavered, without a sound.
A small piece of me is missing.
I slowly fill it back in.
I don't much mind.
I am standing right again.
You are holding that thing.
It has a very definite edge.
I reach, and can't touch it.
Set it down and see.
It feels wrong in my hand.
This colour is very solid.
May I look?
You let go and it falls.
I don't much need it.
Keep it; I can't hold it.
You passed into my body.
I'm not quite sure this is a collision.
Your shape got knocked crooked.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀，和我的重叠了。
lines.en: Your shoulder overlapped mine.
We touched, and it doesn't count.
I withdraw and my edge scatters.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀和我的重叠了。
lines.en: Your shoulder overlapped mine.
I steady you, and you don't feel it.
The ground here is unreliable.
Steady — the ground here isn't.

lines.zh: 我不太确定我有一个我。
lines.en: I'm not sure I have a me.
That thing you mention, I don't have.

lines.zh: 我在这块末地石上待了很久。
lines.en: I have stood on this end stone a long while.
Overlap with me a while.
I'm not good at coming close.
Your edges are very clear.
I try to draw myself smaller.
When you speak, I don't quite follow.
The wind is wrong here.
I reach out and my hand passes through.
It isn't quite real in my hand.
I lift it, then set it down.
This one is square.
I can't see its back.
It is somewhat heavy, and not.

lines.zh: 我把它轻轻放到石头上。
lines.en: I set it gently on the stone.
Will this stay?
You pick it up.
You struck the air.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，护甲却很厚。
lines.en: I move slowly, but my armor is thick.

lines.zh: 你的意图很清楚，我的不是。
lines.en: Your intent is clear; mine isn't.
I raise a hand; its outline blurs.

lines.zh: 这里的空间让开给我了。
lines.en: The space here makes way for me.

lines.zh: 你退得太快，撞到了自己。
lines.en: You retreated too fast and hit yourself.
You turn, and I'm there at your side.

lines.zh: 末地高地的我，走得很慢。
lines.en: On the End highlands, I move slowly.
I lost count of your blows.
You may try again.

lines.zh: 末地高地上，我一步步逼近。
lines.en: On the End highlands I close in a step at a time.
My edge has reached your side.
I circle you, my edge trembling.

lines.zh: 你抬头找我，我不在上面。
lines.en: You look up; I'm not above.
I stretch my body out a little.
That stone isn't solid.
I walk pressed against you.

lines.zh: 你的脚步在我的影子里。
lines.en: Your steps fall in my shadow.
I don't need speed to reach you.
Do you hear that thin sound?
I am only half a block off.
Our outlines have overlapped.
I spread my body out a little.
Your outline grows clearer.
I reach out and you're struck.
This isn't quite a blow.
My shape presses on you.
You pull back and my edge cuts you.
I'm not good at applying force.
Your hand passes through my arm.
I strike you; the sound is muffled.
You retreat and your shape stretches.
That's all. It's enough.
I push you slightly inward.

lines.zh: 你的边界在我这里模糊了。
lines.en: Your boundary blurs in me.
I show out of the air.
The end stone here is flat.
My edges appear first.
I hear wind far off.
It is very empty here.
I try standing in place.
I'm not sure I'm standing right.

lines.zh: 我开始移动，影子跟不上。
lines.en: I begin to move; my shadow lags.
The quiet here is wrong.
I settle slowly onto the stone.

lines.zh: 火让我的边缘卷了起来。
lines.en: Fire curls my edges.

lines.zh: 我掉下去的时候没有重量。
lines.en: I had no weight as I fell.
Water passes through me and scrambles me.
The blast scatters my shape.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过去了，留下一个洞。
lines.en: Something passed through, leaving a hole.
Spell-light makes me very clear.
I seem to be missing something.

lines.zh: 雷光穿过我，把轮廓照亮。
lines.en: The flash passes through me and lights my outline.

lines.zh: 虚空和我很像，我分不清。
lines.en: The void is very like me; I can't tell.
